title: ui: modernize finished export cards with thumbnails

commit.merge_subject: merge: ui: modernize finished export cards with thumbnails

description:
Done cards on the Exports screen are now thin-outlined rounded cards with
a 96dp 16:9 thumbnail on the leading side, loaded off the main thread
(MP4: output frame at ~1 s via MediaMetadataRetriever, scaled down, from
the job file or published uri; DNG/photo/linear: the library's existing
ThumbnailStore PNG), cached in a 24-entry LruCache, neutral placeholder
icon meanwhile.

The clip name is shown once (title); the status line is just "Done".
The subtitle names the real codec from the report mime (HEVC MP4 etc.),
falling back to the old format text when unknown.
Open is a filled 48dp+ button; an info icon button to its left expands
the technical details (encoder, retry and CPU-fallback notes). Resolution,
fps, codec/depth, bitrate and size stay visible, as does the 10-bit-
dropped warning. Whole-card tap still opens; running/queued/failed cards
and Cancel/Retry/Clear unchanged.
